audioOwnershipPolicy.embeddedScenes: When a scene hasEmbeddedSoundtrack=true, the video file's own soundtrack is the ONLY audio for that scene. Never play a standalone mix file or a VO take simultaneously.
audioOwnershipPolicy.standaloneMixFiles: Files under ClientGodot/assets/audio/mix/** are the same mixes delivered as separate files for review and alternate routing. They are alternates OF the embedded soundtrack, not layers on top of it.
audioOwnershipPolicy.voTakes: VO takes under Art_Source/Audio/Muse/VO/ and ClientGodot/assets/audio/vo/ are components already mixed into the embedded soundtracks. Never schedule them over a scene whose mix is embedded.
audioOwnershipPolicy.subtitles: Runtime playback = clean video + SRT overlay. Burned-subtitle variants are REVIEW ONLY and must never be combined with the overlay (no double captions).
audioOwnershipPolicy.questSemantics: Rewatch, skip, already-seen and fallback playback grant NO quest progress. (Adapter rule recorded from WO32 item 4; enforcement is Codex's runtime work.)
